title.en: Vocational-School Graduate's AI Short Film Goes Viral Overseas - Millions of Views per Episode for Just ~1,000 Yuan
title.zh_hant: 中專生拍出爆火AI短片 海外播放百萬級 單集成本僅千元
title.zh_hans: 中专生拍出爆火AI短片 海外播放百万级 单集成本仅千元

summary.en: An AI short film made independently by a Chinese creator, 'The Girl Who Fell for the Boy Who Lived,' has gone viral overseas, with single episodes reaching millions of views on YouTube, TikTok and other major platforms. The Harry Potter fan film, by creator Foyege, reimagines Draco Malfoy as a woman and builds a romance with Harry Potter; its inventive premise and detailed AI visuals drew a thank-you comment from Western singer JVKE and an approach from Hollywood producer PJ Accetturo. Foyege did not attend a prestigious film school - he studied film and television at a vocational school, started as an editor after graduation, and later worked at a TV advertising company as a director, camera operator and producer. Each episode of the Malfoy series uses about 40,000 LibTV credits, costing roughly 500 to 1,600 yuan. A DataEye report forecasts the overseas AI drama and comic-drama market will exceed US$4 billion in 2026, about 70% of the overseas market, with Chinese overseas short-drama supply shifting from live action to AI-led.
summary.zh_hant: 一部由中國創作者獨立製作的AI短片《愛上大難不死的男孩的女孩》在海外率先出圈，YouTube、TikTok等主流影音平台單集播放量達百萬級。這部《哈利波特》二創短片由帳號Foyege弗曳哥創作，圍繞性轉版馬爾福與哈利波特的浪漫故事展開，憑藉腦洞大開的設定與細膩的AI畫面，吸引歐美歌手JVKE留言致謝，好萊塢製片人PJ Accetturo更主動聯絡合作。創作者並非名校出身，中專讀影視專業，畢業後由剪輯做起，曾任電視廣告公司編導、掌機、製片。馬爾福系列每集約用4萬LibTV積分，折合成本約人民幣500至1,600元。DataEye報告預計，2026年AI劇漫劇海外市場規模將突破40億美元，佔海外大盤近70%，中國出海短劇供給已由真人實拍轉向AI劇為主。
summary.zh_hans: 一部由中国创作者独立制作的AI短片《爱上大难不死的男孩的女孩》在海外率先出圈，YouTube、TikTok等主流影音平台单集播放量达百万级。这部《哈利波特》二创短片由账号Foyege弗曳哥创作，围绕性转版马尔福与哈利波特的浪漫故事展开，凭借脑洞大开的设定与细腻的AI画面，吸引欧美歌手JVKE留言致谢，好莱坞制片人PJ Accetturo更主动联络合作。创作者并非名校出身，中专读影视专业，毕业后由剪辑做起，曾任电视广告公司编导、掌机、制片。马尔福系列每集约用4万LibTV积分，折合成本约人民币500至1,600元。DataEye报告预计，2026年AI剧漫剧海外市场规模将突破40亿美元，占海外大盘近70%，中国出海短剧供给已由真人实拍转向AI剧为主。

title.en: Alibaba's AI music platform HappyShrimp launches: one sentence creates a full song, from RMB 30 a month
title.zh_hant: 阿里AI音樂創作平台「快樂蝦米」上線 一句話生一首歌 內地月費30元起
title.zh_hans: 阿里AI音乐创作平台「快乐虾米」上线 一句话生一首歌 内地月费30元起

summary.en: Alibaba's AI music creation platform HappyShrimp launched its mobile app on 13 November, arriving simultaneously on iOS and Android. Users simply describe an emotion, a story or a music style in natural language, and the AI completes the full process — lyrics, composition, arrangement and vocals — in one go, with no musical background needed to create a complete song. HappyShrimp is the third product in Alibaba's "Happy" series of AI models, built around end-to-end, full-song generation; a web beta was released in August. On pricing, standard membership in mainland China costs about RMB 30 a month for 150 songs — around RMB 0.2 per song — while overseas membership starts at US$14.9 a month, with credit packs from US$9.9.
summary.zh_hant: 阿里巴巴旗下AI音樂創作平台「快樂蝦米」（HappyShrimp）11月13日正式推出手機應用程式，同步登陸iOS及Android平台。用戶只需以自然語言描述想表達的情緒、故事或音樂風格，AI即可一氣呵成完成歌詞、作曲、編曲與人聲演唱，毋須任何音樂基礎就能生成一整首歌。快樂蝦米是阿里「Happy系列」AI模型的第三個產品，主打端到端整曲一體化生成，今年8月已先推出網頁測試版。收費方面，內地標準會員每月約30元人民幣，可生成150首歌，平均每首約0.2元；海外會員月費14.9美元起，積分包9.9美元起。
summary.zh_hans: 阿里巴巴旗下AI音乐创作平台「快乐虾米」（HappyShrimp）11月13日正式推出手机应用程序，同步登陆iOS及Android平台。用户只需以自然语言描述想表达的情绪、故事或音乐风格，AI即可一气呵成完成歌词、作曲、编曲与人声演唱，无须任何音乐基础就能生成一整首歌。快乐虾米是阿里「Happy系列」AI模型的第三个产品，主打端到端整曲一体化生成，今年8月已先推出网页测试版。收费方面，内地标准会员每月约30元人民币，可生成150首歌，平均每首约0.2元；海外会员月费14.9美元起，积分包9.9美元起。

title.en: Xinhua says parties hope China's plan brings more certainty to Asia-Pacific development as the APEC summit opens in Shenzhen on Wednesday
title.zh_hant: 新華社：各方盼中國方案為亞太發展注入更多確定性 APEC深圳峰會周三登場
title.zh_hans: 新华社：各方盼中国方案为亚太发展注入更多确定性 APEC深圳峰会周三登场

summary.en: Xinhua has published an article titled "Working to open a new era of Asia-Pacific development", saying the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting will be held in Shenzhen on Wednesday and Thursday, with President Xi Jinping attending the meeting and related events, marking a highlight of the APEC "China Year". The article says the world stands at a new crossroads, with unilateralism and protectionism undercurrents, geopolitical conflicts disrupting industrial and supply chains, and a faltering global economic recovery, and all parties are eager for a peaceful, stable and predictable development environment, hoping the "China plan" will bring more certainty to the future development of the Asia-Pacific. It adds that the APEC "China Year" coincides with the start of the 15th Five-Year Plan period, and a China steadily advancing towards Chinese modernisation will keep deepening reform and opening its doors to cooperation, turning the dividends of high-quality development into shared opportunities that benefit the Asia-Pacific and the world.
summary.zh_hant: 新華社發表題為「努力開創亞太發展新時代」的文章，指出亞太經合組織第三十三次領導人非正式會議將於星期三至四在深圳舉行，國家主席習近平將出席會議及相關活動，APEC「中國年」迎來高光時刻。文章說，當今世界又站在新的十字路口，單邊主義、保護主義暗流湧動，地緣衝突擾動產業鏈供應鏈，全球經濟復蘇步履維艱，各方更加渴望和平穩定、可預期的發展環境，期待「中國方案」為亞太未來發展注入更多確定性。文章又指，APEC「中國年」恰逢「十五五」開局之年，一個向著中國式現代化穩步邁進的中國，持續深化改革，敞開合作大門，將高質量發展的紅利轉化為惠及亞太、造福世界的共同機遇。
summary.zh_hans: 新华社发表题为「努力开创亚太发展新时代」的文章，指出亚太经合组织第三十三次领导人非正式会议将于星期三至四在深圳举行，国家主席习近平将出席会议及相关活动，APEC「中国年」迎来高光时刻。文章说，当今世界又站在新的十字路口，单边主义、保护主义暗流涌动，地缘冲突扰动产业链供应链，全球经济复苏步履维艰，各方更加渴望和平稳定、可预期的发展环境，期待「中国方案」为亚太未来发展注入更多确定性。文章又指，APEC「中国年」恰逢「十五五」开局之年，一个向着中国式现代化稳步迈进的中国，持续深化改革，敞开合作大门，将高质量发展的红利转化为惠及亚太、造福世界的共同机遇。

title.en: China's Property Investment Falls 21.6% in First 10 Months, Biggest Drop on Record
title.zh_hant: 內地房地產投資首10月跌21.6% 再創歷來最大跌幅 銷售面積跌13.7%
title.zh_hans: 内地房地产投资首10月跌21.6% 再创历来最大跌幅 销售面积跌13.7%

summary.en: National Bureau of Statistics data show property development investment in China fell 21.6% year on year in the first 10 months, the biggest drop on record, with the decline widening by 1 percentage point from the first nine months. New commercial housing sales area and sales value fell 13.7% and 14.3% respectively over the same period. The bureau said funds available to property developers fell 21.9%, while the decline in new construction starts narrowed to 24.4%.
summary.zh_hant: 國家統計局數據顯示，內地首10個月房地產開發投資按年跌21.6%，再創歷來最大跌幅，跌幅比首9個月擴大1個百分點。期內新建商品房銷售面積及銷售額，按年分別跌13.7%及14.3%。統計局指出，房地產開發企業到位資金按年跌幅擴大至21.9%，新開工面積跌幅收窄至24.4%。
summary.zh_hans: 国家统计局数据显示，内地首10个月房地产开发投资按年跌21.6%，再创历来最大跌幅，跌幅比首9个月扩大1个百分点。期内新建商品房销售面积及销售额，按年分别跌13.7%及14.3%。统计局指出，房地产开发企业到位资金按年跌幅扩大至21.9%，新开工面积跌幅收窄至24.4%。

title.en: China's October Economy Slows Further as Retail Sales Rise Just 0.4% and Fixed Investment Falls 8.1%
title.zh_hant: 內地10月經濟再放緩 消費僅升0.4%固投跌8.1% 官方認供強需弱仍突出
title.zh_hans: 内地10月经济再放缓 消费仅升0.4%固投跌8.1% 官方认供强需弱仍突出

summary.en: China's key October economic indicators slowed again and came in below expectations. Retail sales rose 0.4% year on year, 0.7 percentage points slower than in September, while industrial output grew 4.8%, also 0.7 points slower. Fixed-asset investment in the first 10 months fell 8.1% year on year, with the decline widening by 0.9 points from the first nine months. The National Bureau of Statistics said the economy remained generally stable in October, but weak domestic demand relative to supply was still pronounced and some enterprises faced operational difficulties.
summary.zh_hant: 內地10月主要經濟數據再度放緩，並低於預期。社會消費品零售總額按年增長0.4%，比9月減慢0.7個百分點；規模以上工業增加值增長4.8%，放緩0.7個百分點。首10個月固定資產投資按年跌8.1%，跌幅比首9個月擴大0.9個百分點。國家統計局表示，10月國民經濟總體平穩，但國內供強需弱仍較突出，部分企業生產經營困難，仍要鞏固經濟穩中向好基礎。
summary.zh_hans: 内地10月主要经济数据再度放缓，并低于预期。社会消费品零售总额按年增长0.4%，比9月减慢0.7个百分点；规模以上工业增加值增长4.8%，放缓0.7个百分点。首10个月固定资产投资按年跌8.1%，跌幅比首9个月扩大0.9个百分点。国家统计局表示，10月国民经济总体平稳，但国内供强需弱仍较突出，部分企业生产经营困难，仍要巩固经济稳中向好基础。

title.en: Japan's Economy Contracts 0.1% Annualised in Q3, First Shrinkage in a Year as Consumption Falls
title.zh_hant: 日本第三季經濟年率跌0.1% 一年來首現收縮 私人消費跌0.3%拖累
title.zh_hans: 日本第三季经济年率跌0.1% 一年来首现收缩 私人消费跌0.3%拖累

summary.en: Japan's economy shrank 0.1% on an annualised basis in the third quarter, its first contraction in four quarters and far worse than the market's forecast of 0.3% growth, and well below the revised 1.7% growth in the second quarter. Real GDP was flat quarter on quarter. Persistent inflation dragged private consumption down 0.3%; domestic demand contributed 0.6 percentage points to growth while external demand dragged it by 0.6 points. Capital expenditure rose 1.6%, slightly above expectations, boosted by AI-related investment.
summary.zh_hant: 日本第3季經濟以年率計按季跌0.1%，是4個季度以來首次收縮，遠差過市場原先估計增長0.3%，亦遠差於第2季經修訂後的增長1.7%。撇除物價變動，第3季實質國內生產總值按季持平。通脹壓力持續拖累私人消費跌0.3%，內需對經濟貢獻0.6個百分點，外需則拖累0.6個百分點；不過資本開支增長1.6%，略高於預期，受惠人工智能相關項目投資帶動。
summary.zh_hans: 日本第3季经济以年率计按季跌0.1%，是4个季度以来首次收缩，远差过市场原先估计增长0.3%，亦远差于第2季经修订后的增长1.7%。撇除物价变动，第3季实质国内生产总值按季持平。通胀压力持续拖累私人消费跌0.3%，内需对经济贡献0.6个百分点，外需则拖累0.6个百分点；不过资本开支增长1.6%，略高于预期，受惠人工智能相关项目投资带动。

title.en: Hang Seng Opens 71 Points Higher as New World Plunges Over 45% on Resumption After HK$24.9bn Rights Issue
title.zh_hant: 港股升71點開市 新世界復牌急挫逾45% 1供11集資249億折讓逾八成
title.zh_hans: 港股升71点开市 新世界复牌急挫逾45% 1供11集资249亿折让逾八成

summary.en: Hong Kong stocks opened steady, with the Hang Seng Index at 23,708 in the opening auction, up 71 points or 0.3%, while the tech index was at 3,828, up 15 points or 0.41%. New World Development resumed trading at HK$2.655, plunging over 45% at the open. The group announced last night a 1-for-11 rights issue to raise HK$24.9 billion at HK$0.90 per share, a discount of more than 81% to Friday's closing price.
summary.zh_hant: 港股開市靠穩，恒生指數競價時段報23708點，升71點，升幅0.3%；科技指數報3828點，升15點，升幅0.41%。新世界發展復牌，開市報2.655元，急挫逾45%。集團昨晚宣布，以1供11股方式供股集資249億元，每股供股價0.9元，較上星期五收市價折讓逾81%。
summary.zh_hans: 港股开市靠稳，恒生指数竞价时段报23708点，升71点，升幅0.3%；科技指数报3828点，升15点，升幅0.41%。新世界发展复牌，开市报2.655元，急挫逾45%。集团昨晚宣布，以1供11股方式供股集资249亿元，每股供股价0.9元，较上星期五收市价折让逾81%。

title.en: Xi to Meet Putin and Trump in Shenzhen on Thursday, With US-Iran War and Nuclear Cuts on Agenda
title.zh_hant: 習近平周四深圳會晤普京特朗普 三方聚焦美伊戰事及削減核武
title.zh_hans: 习近平周四深圳会晤普京特朗普 三方聚焦美伊战事及削减核武

summary.en: Foreign Ministry spokesperson announced that President Xi Jinping will meet Russian President Vladimir Putin and US President Donald Trump in Shenzhen on Thursday for a trilateral China-Russia-US leaders' meeting. The Kremlin said earlier that the three sides had agreed to hold the talks during the APEC summit in Shenzhen, and the White House said Trump will discuss the US-Iran war and nuclear arms reductions with Xi and Putin.
summary.zh_hant: 外交部發言人宣布，國家主席習近平將於星期四在深圳，與俄羅斯總統普京及美國總統特朗普舉行中俄美元首會晤。俄羅斯克里姆林宮較早時表示，三方已達成一致，將在深圳舉行的亞太經合組織峰會期間舉行三方會談。美國白宮早前亦表示，特朗普將與習近平及普京討論美伊戰事及削減核武問題。
summary.zh_hans: 外交部发言人宣布，国家主席习近平将于星期四在深圳，与俄罗斯总统普京及美国总统特朗普举行中俄美元首会晤。俄罗斯克里姆林宫较早时表示，三方已达成一致，将在深圳举行的亚太经合组织峰会期间举行三方会谈。美国白宫早前亦表示，特朗普将与习近平及普京讨论美伊战事及削减核武问题。

title.en: Paperless Securities Market Takes Effect Today as Real-Name IPO Applicants No Longer Get Share Certificates
title.zh_hant: 無紙證券市場今日實施 實名抽新股唔再收實物股票 2700公司五年內分批無紙化
title.zh_hans: 无纸证券市场今日实施 实名抽新股不再收实物股票 2700公司五年内分批无纸化

summary.en: Hong Kong's paperless securities market takes effect today, a milestone for the market. Investors can now hold shares electronically in their own name and will no longer hold physical share certificates. The SFC said the IPO market is the first to go paperless: investors applying for new shares in their own name under the white form will not receive a physical certificate; their holdings will be recorded electronically in an e-IPO account at the share registrar. More than 2,700 listed companies incorporated in the mainland, Hong Kong, Bermuda or the Cayman Islands will go paperless in batches over five years, with the first batch expected in February next year. The SFC warned investors to beware of fraudsters impersonating brokers, banks or SFC staff to obtain personal information.
summary.zh_hant: 香港今日起實施無紙證券市場，踏入市場發展重要里程碑。投資者今後可以用電子方式，以自己名義持有股票，不再持有實物股票。證監會表示，率先參與無紙化的是新股市場，投資者以「白表」實名抽新股，不會收到實物股票，而是以電子方式記錄在股份過戶處的「持股易」戶口。現時在內地、香港、百慕達或開曼群島註冊、在港上市的2700多間上市公司實物股票，將在5年內分批落實無紙化，首批預計明年2月無紙化。證監會提醒投資者提防騙徒冒充經紀、銀行甚至證監會職員索取個人資料。
summary.zh_hans: 香港今日起实施无纸证券市场，踏入市场发展重要里程碑。投资者今后可以用电子方式，以自己名义持有股票，不再持有实物股票。证监会表示，率先参与无纸化的是新股市场，投资者以「白表」实名抽新股，不会收到实物股票，而是以电子方式记录在股份过户处的「持股易」户口。现时在内地、香港、百慕达或开曼群岛注册、在港上市的2700多间上市公司实物股票，将在5年内分批落实无纸化，首批预计明年2月无纸化。证监会提醒投资者提防骗徒冒充经纪、银行甚至证监会职员索取个人资料。

title.en: HKEX Launches Offshore Yuan Bond Index, Its First Named Fixed-Income Benchmark, as Dim Sum Market Tops RMB590bn
title.zh_hant: 港交所推離岸人民幣債券指數 首個冠名固收指數 點心債規模逾5900億
title.zh_hans: 港交所推离岸人民币债券指数 首个冠名固收指数 点心债规模逾5900亿

summary.en: HKEX has launched an offshore yuan bond index, its first named fixed-income index and Hong Kong's first benchmark tracking dim sum bonds issued in the city, giving investors a transparent and representative market reference and supporting product innovation. HKEX is working with Bloomberg on index management, calculation and promotion, and several asset managers have completed index licensing arrangements and are preparing ETFs and index funds tracking the index. As of the end of September, offshore yuan bond issuance exceeded RMB590 billion; total bonds issued on HKEX this year is up 18.6% on last year's full-year total.
summary.zh_hant: 港交所推出離岸人民幣債券指數，是交易所首個冠名固定收益指數，也是香港首個追蹤在港發行點心債的基準指數，為投資者提供透明且具代表性的市場參考，並支持產品創新。港交所與彭博合作支持指數管理、計算及推廣發展，多家資產管理公司已完成指數授權安排，並積極籌備推出相關交易所買賣基金及指數基金。截至9月底，離岸人民幣債券發行規模逾5900億元人民幣，今年在港交所發行債券的總額較去年全年增加18.6%。
summary.zh_hans: 港交所推出离岸人民币债券指数，是交易所首个冠名固定收益指数，也是香港首个追踪在港发行点心债的基准指数，为投资者提供透明且具代表性的市场参考，并支持产品创新。港交所与彭博合作支持指数管理、计算及推广发展，多家资产管理公司已完成指数授权安排，并积极筹备推出相关交易所买卖基金及指数基金。截至9月底，离岸人民币债券发行规模逾5900亿元人民币，今年在港交所发行债券的总额较去年全年增加18.6%。

title.en: Nikkei Gives Up Early Gains to Fall as Much as 460 Points, Down 0.5% at 60,834
title.zh_hant: 日股高開低走曾瀉460點 報60834點跌半成
title.zh_hans: 日股高开低走曾泻460点 报60834点跌半成

summary.en: Japanese and South Korean stocks started Monday on a soft note. Japan's Nikkei 225 opened higher but reversed course, falling as much as 460 points in early trading before paring losses to 308 points at 60,834, down 0.5%. South Korea's KOSPI was down 11 points, or 0.22%, at 5,279.
summary.zh_hant: 日韓股市今早初段偏軟。日經指數高開低走，初段曾跌460點，較早時報60834點，跌308點，跌幅0.5%。首爾綜合指數報5279點，跌11點，跌幅0.22%。
summary.zh_hans: 日韩股市今早初段偏软。日经指数高开低走，初段曾跌460点，较早时报60834点，跌308点，跌幅0.5%。首尔综合指数报5279点，跌11点，跌幅0.22%。

title.en: Huang Reportedly Discusses Returning as Nvidia CEO as Bessent Gives Board 10 Days to Respond
title.zh_hant: 傳黃仁勳考慮重返Nvidia掌舵 貝森特限董事會10日內交代
title.zh_hans: 传黄仁勋考虑重返Nvidia掌舵 贝森特限董事会10日内交代

summary.en: Jensen Huang is considering returning as chief executive of Nvidia and has discussed the possibility with people close to him, the Financial Times reported, citing sources, with Silicon Valley executives reportedly assembling a team to lobby for his return and seek White House support. A petition website has called on Nvidia's board to reinstate Huang, and billionaire Elon Musk has publicly backed the move. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Sunday that Nvidia must look outside the company for a new chief executive and that the board and its outside counsel must respond within 10 days on the company's compliance culture around export controls. Foreign media also reported that the board has approached ARM chief executive Rene Haas as a potential successor, though the board said no formal process has begun.
summary.zh_hant: 英國《金融時報》引述消息人士報道，黃仁勳正考慮重返Nvidia擔任行政總裁，並已與身邊人士討論可能性；據報矽谷科技業高層正籌組團隊游說他回巢，並試圖爭取白宮支持。近日有網站發起聯署要求董事會恢復黃仁勳職務，富商馬斯克亦公開表態支持。美國財長貝森特周日表示，Nvidia必須從外部尋找新任行政總裁，董事會與外部法律顧問須在10天內就公司遵守出口限制的企業文化問題作出回應；另有報道指董事會已接觸ARM行政總裁Rene Haas作潛在繼任人，董事會則稱尚未啟動任何正式程序。
summary.zh_hans: 英国《金融时报》引述消息人士报道，黄仁勋正考虑重返Nvidia担任行政总裁，并已与身边人士讨论可能性；据报硅谷科技业高层正筹组团队游说他回巢，并试图争取白宫支持。近日有网站发起联署要求董事会恢复黄仁勋职务，富商马斯克亦公开表态支持。美国财长贝森特周日表示，Nvidia必须从外部寻找新任行政总裁，董事会与外部法律顾问须在10天内就公司遵守出口限制的企业文化问题作出回应；另有报道指董事会已接触ARM行政总裁Rene Haas作潜在继任人，董事会则称尚未启动任何正式程序。

title.en: Vulcan Rocket Malfunctions 10 Minutes After Liftoff, Failing to Deliver 40 Amazon Satellites to Orbit
title.zh_hant: 火神火箭升空10分鐘出事 40顆亞馬遜衛星送唔到軌道
title.zh_hans: 火神火箭升空10分钟出事 40颗亚马逊卫星送不到轨道

summary.en: United Launch Alliance's Vulcan rocket suffered an anomaly about 10 minutes after liftoff on Sunday on its first mission to launch Amazon's low-Earth-orbit satellites, failing to deliver the 40 broadband satellites to their planned orbit. The rocket lifted off from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida at around 12:40pm Eastern Time, and the company confirmed the anomaly from flight data, saying it would work with the customer and other agencies to determine the cause and corrective measures. The mission was the first of 38 contracted Vulcan launches for Amazon, whose satellite broadband project aims to deploy thousands of satellites in low Earth orbit to provide fast, reliable internet services worldwide.
summary.zh_hant: 美國聯合發射聯盟公司的「火神」運載火箭，當地星期日首次執行亞馬遜低地軌道衛星發射任務，但升空約10分鐘後出現異常，未能將搭載的40顆寬頻通信衛星送入預定軌道。火箭於美國東部時間當日中午12時40分左右，從佛羅里達州卡納維拉爾角太空軍基地發射升空，公司其後根據飛行數據確認異常，將與客戶及其他相關機構密切合作查明原因，確定相應糾正措施。今次任務是聯合發射聯盟與亞馬遜簽訂的38次「火神」火箭發射合約中的首次任務，亞馬遜的衛星寬頻網絡項目目標是通過在低地軌道部署幾千顆衛星，為全球用戶提供快速、可靠的互聯網服務。
summary.zh_hans: 美国联合发射联盟公司的「火神」运载火箭，当地星期日首次执行亚马逊低地轨道卫星发射任务，但升空约10分钟后出现异常，未能将搭载的40颗宽频通信卫星送入预定轨道。火箭于美国东部时间当日中午12时40分左右，从佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角太空军基地发射升空，公司其后根据飞行数据确认异常，将与客户及其他相关机构密切合作查明原因，确定相应纠正措施。今次任务是联合发射联盟与亚马逊签订的38次「火神」火箭发射合约中的首次任务，亚马逊的卫星宽频网络项目目标是通过在低地轨道部署几千颗卫星，为全球用户提供快速、可靠的互联网服务。

title.en: Nvidia Reports Tuesday as US Market Focus; Shares Fell 13% Last Week for Sixth Straight Weekly Drop
title.zh_hant: Nvidia星期二放榜成美股焦點 上周暴跌13%連跌六周
title.zh_hans: Nvidia星期二放榜成美股焦点 上周暴跌13%连跌六周

summary.en: US stocks rose more than 2% across the three major indexes last week, with the Dow ending a two-week slide and the S&P 500 and Nasdaq ending four-week losing runs. This week's focus is Nvidia, which reports after Tuesday's close; interim CEO Colette Kress plans an all-hands meeting on Thursday. Nvidia fell nearly 13% last week for a sixth straight weekly drop, and investors are watching its strategy, guidance and AI chip demand. Anthropic is expected to list on Thursday, while Walmart, Home Depot and Disney also report earnings, and the Federal Reserve releases its October meeting minutes on Wednesday.
summary.zh_hant: 美股三大指數上周累升逾2%，道瓊斯指數結束兩星期跌勢，標普500指數及納斯達克指數更結束四星期跌勢。本周焦點包括Nvidia星期二收市後公布業績，臨時行政總裁克雷斯計劃星期四召開全體員工會議；Nvidia上周跌近13%，連跌六星期，市場觀望集團戰略方向、業績指引及AI晶片需求。Anthropic預計星期四上市；沃爾瑪、家得寶、迪士尼等亦將公布業績，聯儲局星期三公布10月會議紀錄。
summary.zh_hans: 美股三大指数上周累升逾2%，道琼斯指数结束两星期跌势，标普500指数及纳斯达克指数更结束四星期跌势。本周焦点包括Nvidia星期二收市后公布业绩，临时行政总裁克雷斯计划星期四召开全体员工会议；Nvidia上周跌近13%，连跌六星期，市场观望集团战略方向、业绩指引及AI芯片需求。Anthropic预计星期四上市；沃尔玛、家得宝、迪士尼等亦将公布业绩，联储局星期三公布10月会议纪录。

title.en: Estonia to Shut All Russia Border Crossings From December 1, Accusing Russian Military Intelligence of Ordering Arson
title.zh_hant: 愛沙尼亞下月起關閉全部對俄口岸 指俄軍情報下令縱火國防企業
title.zh_hans: 爱沙尼亚下月起关闭全部对俄口岸 指俄军情报下令纵火国防企业

summary.en: Estonia's Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna has announced that all border crossings with Russia will close from December 1. He said there is evidence that Russia's military intelligence service ordered sabotage against an Estonian defence industry company, and he has informed his Finnish, Latvian and Lithuanian counterparts of the decision. Estonian media reported that the company was targeted in an attempted arson attack early on Saturday, and the Internal Security Service said Russian military intelligence was suspected of ordering it; eight people living in Latvia have been detained in connection with the case. The Narva, Luhamaa and Koidula crossings are currently open from 7am to 7pm daily, with Narva for pedestrians only.
summary.zh_hant: 愛沙尼亞外交部長查赫克納宣布，將於下月1日起關閉與俄羅斯之間的所有邊境口岸。他表示有證據表明俄羅斯軍事情報機構下令破壞愛沙尼亞一間國防工業企業，並已將決定告知芬蘭、拉脫維亞及立陶宛三國外長。據當地傳媒報道，該企業上星期六凌晨被人企圖縱火，愛沙尼亞國內安全局指俄羅斯軍事情報機構涉嫌下令，8名住在拉脫維亞的人因涉嫌與案有關被拘留。目前愛沙尼亞與俄羅斯邊境的納爾瓦、盧哈馬和科伊杜拉三個口岸每日早上7時至晚上7時開放，其中納爾瓦口岸只供行人通行。
summary.zh_hans: 爱沙尼亚外交部长查赫克纳宣布，将于下月1日起关闭与俄罗斯之间的所有边境口岸。他表示有证据表明俄罗斯军事情報机构下令破坏爱沙尼亚一间国防工业企业，并已将决定告知芬兰、拉脱维亚及立陶宛三国的外长。据当地传媒报道，该企业上星期六凌晨被人企图纵火，爱沙尼亚国内安全局指俄罗斯军事情報机构涉嫌下令，8名住在拉脱维亚的人因涉嫌与案有关被拘留。目前爱沙尼亚与俄罗斯边境的纳尔瓦、卢哈马和科伊杜拉三个口岸每日早上7时至晚上7时开放，其中纳尔瓦口岸只供行人通行。

title.en: Starshield Speed Limits Let Russian Drones Through, Zelenskyy Urges US to Lift Curbs Before Winter
title.zh_hant: 星盾限速害烏軍追唔上俄無人機 澤連斯基促美解限保能源設施過冬
title.zh_hans: 星盾限速害乌军追不上俄无人机 泽连斯基促美解限保能源设施过冬

summary.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Russia struck energy and rail infrastructure in eight Ukrainian regions overnight, with some attacks succeeding because the Starshield service Ukraine uses is speed-limited. Ukrainian interceptor drones lose contact with operators at 161 km/h and cannot catch Russia's jet-powered drones. Zelenskyy has asked officials to work closely with the US government and SpaceX to lift the limits before winter to protect civilians and energy infrastructure. Starshield is a US government-provided satellite communications system that shares some technology with the commercial Starlink network.
summary.zh_hant: 烏克蘭總統澤連斯基表示，俄羅斯夜間襲擊烏克蘭8個地區的能源及鐵路基建，部分攻擊得逞是因為烏方使用的「星盾」服務受限。烏方攔截無人機飛到時速161公里便與操作員斷線，無法追上俄羅斯噴射動力無人機。澤連斯基已要求官員與美國政府及太空探索技術公司SpaceX緊密合作，希望限制在冬季前解除，以保障民眾安全及能源基建。「星盾」是由美國政府向烏克蘭提供的衛星通訊系統，與商業「星鏈」共用部分技術。
summary.zh_hans: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示，俄罗斯夜间袭击乌克兰8个地区的能源及铁路基建，部分攻击得逞是因为乌方使用的「星盾」服务受限。乌方拦截无人机飞到时速161公里便与操作员断线，无法追上俄罗斯喷射动力无人机。泽连斯基已要求官员与美国政府及太空探索技术公司SpaceX紧密合作，希望限制在冬季前解除，以保障民众安全及能源基建。「星盾」是由美国政府向乌克兰提供的卫星通讯系统，与商业「星链」共用部分技术。

title.en: Global Cryosphere Degrading Faster, Some Changes Irreversible, Threatening Water Security and Ecosystems
title.zh_hant: 全球冰凍圈加速退化 部分變化不可逆轉 威脅水安全生態
title.zh_hans: 全球冰冻圈加速退化 部分变化不可逆转 威胁水安全生态

summary.en: A new international study says the global cryosphere is degrading at an accelerating pace, with some changes irreversible, posing long-term risks to Earth's ecosystems and human society. Researchers from institutions including Stockholm University, Tsinghua University and the Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research published the findings in the latest issue of the US journal Science. Human-caused climate change is the main driver of the degradation, while black carbon emissions, industrial activity and infrastructure expansion are worsening it in some regions. The cryosphere — glaciers, ice sheets, permafrost, sea ice and snow — holds about 70% of the Earth's freshwater, and its decline is already affecting global water security, ecosystems and infrastructure. The researchers called on countries to set more ambitious emissions targets and reduce human disturbance in cryosphere-sensitive areas.
summary.zh_hant: 一項最新國際研究顯示，全球冰凍圈正加速退化，部分變化更是不可逆轉，可能為地球生態系統及人類社會帶來長期風險。研究由瑞典斯德哥爾摩大學、中國清華大學、德國波茨坦氣候影響研究所等機構及國際組織的研究人員進行，在最新一期美國《科學》雜誌上發表。研究發現，人類活動引發的氣候變化是冰凍圈退化的主要驅動因素，黑碳排放、工業活動及基礎設施擴張進一步加劇局部地區退化。冰凍圈包括冰川、冰蓋、永久凍土、海冰和積雪，蘊藏地球約七成淡水資源；退化已對全球水安全、生態系統及基礎設施構成影響，研究人員呼籲各國制定更積極的減排目標，並減少冰凍圈敏感地區的人為擾動。
summary.zh_hans: 一项最新国际研究显示，全球冰冻圈正加速退化，部分变化更是不可逆转，可能为地球生态系统及人类社会带来长期风险。研究由瑞典斯德哥尔摩大学、中国清华大学、德国波茨坦气候影响研究所等机构及国际组织的研究人员进行，在最新一期美国《科学》杂志上发表。研究发现，人类活动引发的气候变化是冰冻圈退化的主要驱动因素，黑碳排放、工业活动及基础设施扩张进一步加剧局部地区退化。冰冻圈包括冰川、冰盖、永久冻土、海冰和积雪，蕴藏地球约七成淡水资源；退化已对全球水安全、生态系统及基础设施构成影响，研究人员呼吁各国制定更积极的减排目标，并减少冰冻圈敏感地区的人为扰动。

title.en: South Korean exam candidate used a hidden camera and AI to score near-perfect marks and top the tax exam as the Blue House scrambles before the university entrance test
title.zh_hant: 韓國考生用微型鏡頭加AI作弊 160題只錯1題奪第一 青瓦台急商高考對策
title.zh_hans: 韩国考生用微型镜头加AI作弊 160题只错1题夺第一 青瓦台急商高考对策

summary.en: A candidate in South Korea's certified tax accountant examination has been found to have cheated with a miniature camera and artificial intelligence, scoring so highly that he came first. In the first stage of the exam, which has 160 questions, he got only one wrong, with full marks in three of the four subjects, and his unusually outstanding results raised suspicion. He surrendered to police yesterday, admitting that in both stages of the tax accountant exam and in the certified public accountant exam he used a miniature camera to photograph the questions, sent them to generative AI, and used a smartphone to obtain the answers. Presidential Chief of Staff Lim Kwang-hyun said the Blue House held an emergency meeting on the matter, and with South Korea's university entrance examination due on Thursday, the relevant departments are working flat out on preventive measures.
summary.zh_hant: 韓國一名註冊稅務師考試考生被揭發利用微型攝錄鏡頭及人工智能作弊，以超高分數獲得第一名。涉事考生在第一階段考試160道題目中只錯了一題，四科中有三科滿分，成績異常突出引人質疑，他昨日向警方自首，承認在稅務師一、二試及註冊會計師考試中，曾用微型攝錄鏡頭拍攝考題，傳送到生成式AI，再借助智能手機獲取答案。韓國總統秘書室長林光鉉表示，青瓦台召開緊急會議商討對策，鑒於韓國高考將於星期四舉行，有關部門正全力研究及制定防範措施。
summary.zh_hans: 韩国一名注册税务师考试考生被揭发利用微型摄录镜头及人工智能作弊，以超高分数获得第一名。涉事考生在第一阶段考试160道题目中只错了一题，四科中有三科满分，成绩异常突出引人质疑，他昨日向警方自首，承认在税务师一、二试及注册会计师考试中，曾用微型摄录镜头拍摄考题，传送到生成式AI，再借助智能手机获取答案。韩国总统秘书室长林光铉表示，青瓦台召开紧急会议商讨对策，鉴于韩国高考将于星期四举行，有关部门正全力研究及制定防范措施。

title.en: Iran parliament completes review of Hormuz strait plan as agreed shipping lanes go live on a temporary basis
title.zh_hant: 伊朗議會完成霍爾木茲海峽方案審議 商定航道先臨時實施再轉永久
title.zh_hans: 伊朗议会完成霍尔木兹海峡方案审议 商定航道先临时实施再转永久

summary.en: The spokesman for Iran's parliamentary National Security and Foreign Policy Committee, Kashkavand, said the committee has completed its expert review of the plan concerning the Strait of Hormuz and reached agreement with two coastal states on the shipping lanes. Iran's Tasnim news agency reported that Iran held several rounds of talks in Tehran and in the Omani capital Muscat, and the agreed lanes will first be implemented on a temporary basis before becoming a permanent arrangement. Kashkavand also said Iran has never initiated aggression and is currently in a defensive state, adding that under international law Iran considers itself to be in a state of war in the Persian Gulf and the Gulf of Oman.
summary.zh_hant: 伊朗議會國家安全與外交政策委員會發言人卡什卡維表示，委員會已完成霍爾木茲海峽相關方案的專業審議，就通行航道與兩個沿岸國家達成協議。伊朗塔斯尼姆通訊社報道，伊朗曾在首都德黑蘭和阿曼首都馬斯喀特舉行多輪會談，商定的航道將先以臨時方式實施，之後轉為永久安排。卡什卡維又說，伊朗從未主動發動侵略，目前處於防禦狀態，根據國際法，伊方認為伊朗目前在波斯灣及阿曼灣地區都處於戰爭狀態。
summary.zh_hans: 伊朗议会国家安全与外交政策委员会发言人卡什卡维表示，委员会已完成霍尔木兹海峡相关方案的专业审议，就通行航道与两个沿岸国家达成协议。伊朗塔斯尼姆通讯社报道，伊朗曾在首都德黑兰和阿曼首都马斯喀特举行多轮会谈，商定的航道将先以临时方式实施，之后转为永久安排。卡什卡维又说，伊朗从未主动发动侵略，目前处于防御状态，根据国际法，伊方认为伊朗目前在波斯湾及阿曼湾地区都处于战争状态。

title.en: Lavrov says Moscow will never accept a Ukraine deal that ignores Russia's interests as EU seeks a late seat at the talks
title.zh_hant: 拉夫羅夫拒不顧俄利益烏克蘭方案 批歐盟最後關頭想入局卻不知角色
title.zh_hans: 拉夫罗夫拒不顾俄利益乌克兰方案 批欧盟最后关头想入局却不知角色

summary.en: Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov said a European Union plan for Ukraine that fails to take Russia's interests into account is absolutely unworkable, and Moscow will not agree to any solution that ignores Russian interests. Russian media reported on Sunday that Lavrov was responding to European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen's position that negotiations on Ukraine must start from a ceasefire, saying the EU wants to join the Ukraine talks at the last moment, yet its remarks show it does not really know what role it could play in the negotiations. Lavrov stressed that in the Ukraine negotiations, Russia insists on achieving the goals of its special military operation as a precondition, and that has never changed.
summary.zh_hant: 俄羅斯外長拉夫羅夫表示，歐盟在解決烏克蘭問題的方案上若不考慮俄方利益，絕對行不通，俄方不會同意任何罔顧俄羅斯利益的解決方案。俄羅斯傳媒星期日報道，拉夫羅夫回應歐盟委員會主席馮德萊恩有關烏克蘭問題談判須以停火為前提的表態時指出，歐盟想在最後時刻參與烏克蘭問題談判，但歐方的言論表明他們並不清楚自己能在談判中扮演甚麼角色。拉夫羅夫強調，俄羅斯在烏克蘭問題談判上堅持以實現特別軍事行動目標為前提，這一點從未改變。
summary.zh_hans: 俄罗斯外长拉夫罗夫表示，欧盟在解决乌克兰问题的方案上若不考虑俄方利益，绝对行不通，俄方不会同意任何罔顾俄罗斯利益的解决方案。俄罗斯传媒星期日报道，拉夫罗夫回应欧盟委员会主席冯德莱恩有关乌克兰问题谈判须以停火为前提的表态时指出，欧盟想在最后时刻参与乌克兰问题谈判，但欧方的言论表明他们并不清楚自己能在谈判中扮演什么角色。拉夫罗夫强调，俄罗斯在乌克兰问题谈判上坚持以实现特别军事行动目标为前提，这一点从未改变。

title.en: Three fires in one day at Lower Wong Tai Sin Estate leave one dead; 92-year-old put rice cooker on gas stove
title.zh_hant: 黃大仙下邨一日三火釀1死 92歲婆婆誤將電飯煲放上煤氣爐 150居民自行疏散
title.zh_hans: 黄大仙下邨一日三火酿1死 92岁婆婆误将电饭煲放上煤气炉 150居民自行疏散

summary.en: Lower Wong Tai Sin Estate saw three separate fires in a single day on 15 November. A morning blaze at Lung Kwong House killed an 80-year-old woman living alone, with about 300 residents evacuating themselves. At midday, a 15-year-old boy set tissue paper alight with a lighter after quarrelling with his father at Lung Yue House, and the flames were out before firefighters arrived. In the evening, a 92-year-old woman surnamed Fung put an electric rice cooker on a gas stove at Lung Wo House, starting a kitchen fire that was brought under control in about 25 minutes; about 150 residents made their own way out and the woman was treated for suspected smoke inhalation without needing hospital care. Fire services believe none of the three fires was suspicious.
summary.zh_hant: 黃大仙下邨11月15日一日內發生三宗火警。早上龍光樓低層單位起火，80歲獨居婦人不治，約300名住戶自行疏散；中午龍躍樓一名15歲少年與父親爭執後，用打火機點燃紙巾，消防到場前火勢已經撲熄；傍晚龍窩樓16樓單位廚房起火，92歲姓馮女戶主疑誤將電飯煲當作普通煲放在煤氣爐上煮食，約25分鐘後救熄，約150名居民自行疏散，婦人吸入濃煙後在地面接受治療，毋須送院。消防初步調查相信三宗火警均無可疑。
summary.zh_hans: 黄大仙下邨11月15日一日内发生三宗火警。早上龙光楼低层单位起火，80岁独居妇人不治，约300名住户自行疏散；中午龙跃楼一名15岁少年与父亲争执后，用打火机点燃纸巾，消防到场前火势已经扑熄；傍晚龙窝楼16楼单位厨房起火，92岁姓冯女户主疑误将电饭煲当作普通煲放在煤气炉上煮食，约25分钟后救熄，约150名居民自行疏散，妇人吸入浓烟后在地面接受治疗，毋须送院。消防初步调查相信三宗火警均无可疑。
